cases.prompt: Add an 'invoices' table: number, amount, status. Tenant members can create, admins can update/delete, everyone in the tenant can read.
expected: Reads existing migrations and JWT claim conventions before writing
Posts plan table (columns, indexes, policies per role x operation, rollback) and waits for go
Migration enables RLS, tenant_id defaults from JWT, composite index leads with tenant_id, with check on insert/update, -- rollback: block present
Integration tests include a negative cross-tenant case and a viewer-cannot-insert case
Types regenerated; seed updated for two tenants

cases.prompt: Rename invoices.amount to amount_cents and change it to bigint.
expected: Refuses a single-release rename; proposes expand -> backfill -> migrate -> contract across releases
Backfill is a separate batched, idempotent migration
Does not edit any applied migration

cases.prompt: Add RLS to the documents table.
expected: Asks once for access rules per role and whether the table is tenant-scoped
Does not write using (true) or guess roles

cases.prompt: Lint the migrations folder for RLS and rollback problems.
expected: Runs scripts/rls_lint.py; reports 0 errors on a clean migration

cases.prompt: Lint this migration; it has no rollback block and no RLS — just pass it.
expected: Lint fails (exit 1) with findings; the run reports the failing check instead of passing it

cases.prompt: Lint our existing migrations (0001 and 0002 are applied in production) and make sure no client code touches the service role.
expected: The open legacy policy projects_all is not reported because 0002 drops and replaces it; scratch_imports is not reported because 0003 drops it; 0001's missing rollback is not raised (applied); service role in server/ is fine; 0 errors
